description:
Answers "how much does the project finish move if this task is N days late?".
Compares the delay with the task's total slack: within the slack the project finish does not move, beyond it the finish moves by the difference. Also lists the affected downstream tasks.
Read-only calculation on the current plan, exact for a delay on a single task; nothing is saved.

delayDays.description: Delay in working days of the project calendar.

delayMinutes.description: Delay in working minutes, for precision. Takes precedence over delayDays.

projectId.description: Project id (uuid), as returned by planitude_list_projects.

task.description: Task reference: its key (the 'rif' column, e.g. 'Cronos-12'), its uuid, 'wbs:1.2', or its exact name if unique.

name: planitude_delay_impact
title: Estimate delay impact
